decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (TIMP-STD-004 Rev C1, dated 4.12.13, received 24/07/2014; TIMP-STD-002 Rev C1, dated 4.12.13, received 24/07/2014; TIMP-STD-003 Rev C1, dated 4.12.13, received 24/07/2014; 2128gag1c.dgn Rev 1C, dated 06.08.14, received 11/08/2014; 2128/180714TT/DAS, dated July 2014, received 11/08/2014) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - Before the development commences, details of the covered cycle parking shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority and the covered spaces shown on the approved drawing shall be available for use before the development of the proposed retail unit commences and thereafter maintained and retained as such.
description: Resiting of dry cleaning, key cutting and shoe and watch repairs pod to retail premises.
